messages.subject: dplyr for R 3.1.1
parts:
I notice that the most recent CRAN version of dplyr (0.4.2) has R >= 3.1.2 as a prerequisite. Will there be any problems if I modify the DESCRIPTION file and install it on R 3.1.1? I have some machines running (an older version of) Revolution R Enterprise which uses R 3.1.1 as its base.

If that doesn't work, which version of dplyr should I use?

Thanks
Hong
